risk_if_not_implemented: Without Accountability Information, unauthorized individuals, devices or services may gain access to Technology Assets, Applications, Services, Data and/or Facilities (TAASDF). Based on the risk and threat mapping for this control, this deficiency most likely exposes the organization to Loss of Accountability / Attribution (R-AC-1), Unperformed / Unowned Control Responsibilities (R-GV-3), and most likely increases susceptibility to Human Error (MT-9), Data Quality Degradation / Data Poisoning (MT-12).

compensating_control_1.name: Defined Roles & Responsibilities
compensating_control_1.description: Mechanisms exist to define cybersecurity roles & responsibilities for all personnel.
compensating_control_1.justification: Defined Roles & Responsibilities (HRS-04) provides overlapping security capability that compensates for the absence of Accountability Information (AST-07.2) by addressing related risk objectives through an alternative control mechanism aligned with Process applicability. Given the process-oriented nature of this control, this compensating control targets the same underlying risk objective through an alternative approach, helping to maintain an acceptable level of residual risk until the primary control can be implemented.

compensating_control_2.name: Identification & Authentication for Non-Organizational Users
compensating_control_2.description: Mechanisms exist to uniquely identify and centrally Authenticate, Authorize and Audit (AAA) third-party users and processes that provide services to the organization.
compensating_control_2.justification: Identification & Authentication for Non-Organizational Users (IAC-33) provides access control enforcement that compensates for the absence of Accountability Information (AST-07.2) by restricting system and data access to authorized users through alternative identity and access mechanisms. Given the process-oriented nature of this control, this compensating control targets the same underlying risk objective through an alternative approach, helping to maintain an acceptable level of residual risk until the primary control can be implemented.
